O MMisc é um app para dar nota e escreve: MMisc is an app for rating and reviewing everything you experience: albums, films, series, games, books, bars, public restrooms and cities. You keep a diary of what you watched, listened to and visited, save what you want to see later and follow what your friends think.

Esta política explica quais dados o MMis: This policy explains what data MMisc (www.mmisc.com.br) collects, what it's used for and how you can request access, correction or deletion, under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law 13,709/2018). Questions: {email}.
{rotulo} seu e-mail. Se você entrar com: {rotulo} your email. If you sign in with Google, we also receive the name, email and profile photo from your Google account (scopes {escopos}). We don't access Gmail, contacts, calendar or any other Google data.
{rotulo} nome de exibição, @ de usuário: {rotulo} display name, username @ and photo, which you can change any time.
{rotulo} notas, textos, fotos, datas, on: {rotulo} ratings, texts, photos, dates, where and with whom you watched, likes, comments, “want to see” list and the streaming services you subscribe to.
{rotulo} com quem você é amigo e os conv: {rotulo} who you're friends with and the invites you created or accepted.
Fazer você entrar na sua conta e mantê-l: Signing you in to your account and keeping it secure.
Mostrar seu diário, suas reviews e o que: Showing your diary, your reviews and what your friends post.
Enviar o código de acesso por e-mail e a: Sending the sign-in code by email and notices from the app itself.
Não vendemos seus dados, não mostramos a: We don't sell your data, show ads or use your data for advertising.
Cada review tem uma visibilidade: só voc: Each review has a visibility: only you, your friends or public. Profile name, @ and photo are visible to anyone with an MMisc account.
Todo perfil com @ tem um link público (p: Every profile with an @ has a public link (for example, mmisc.com.br/@yourname) that opens without signing in. It's on by default and can be turned off any time under Profile → Edit → Public profile. Anyone who opens the link sees name, @, photo, cover, bio, links and only what you marked as Public: reviews, favorites and Top 10. Never shown: your friends list, goals, want-to-see list, private notes, who you watched something with, review photos or anything set to friends or only you. Link previews in apps like WhatsApp use the same public content.
Supabase (banco de dados, login e arquiv: Supabase (database, sign-in and files), on servers in São Paulo.
Google (login com Google, se você escolh: Google (sign-in with Google, if you choose it).
Catálogos públicos como TMDB, MusicBrain: Public catalogs such as TMDB, MusicBrainz, IGDB, Open Library, OpenStreetMap and IBGE: they only receive the search term, never your personal data. Where-to-watch data: JustWatch.
O uso que o MMisc faz das informações re: MMisc's use of information received from Google APIs follows the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. We use name, email and photo only to create and identify your account.
Para consertar problemas e saber se o ap: To fix problems and know whether the app is working well, MMisc logs in its own database (on Supabase, in São Paulo, with no other analytics company):
{rotulo} a mensagem técnica do erro, a t: {rotulo} the technical error message, the screen where it happened, the app version and the browser.
{rotulo} alguns eventos sem conteúdo, co: {rotulo} a few events without content, such as opening the app (once a day), opening, saving or cancelling an entry (with how long it took and the category) and a search with no results (just the category, never what you typed).
Nunca entram aí o texto das suas reviews: Never included: the text of your reviews, notes, photos, email or location. This data isn't seen by other users and is deleted after 180 days. You can turn off usage metrics on this device; error reports continue, because they're what lets us fix failures.
Enquanto sua conta existir. Quando você: As long as your account exists. When you request deletion, we delete the account and everything linked to it. Errors and usage metrics: 180 days.
Você pode pedir acesso, correção, cópia: You can request access to, correction, a copy or deletion of your data and revoke Google sign-in at any time. See {como} or write to {email}.
Ao usar o MMisc você concorda com estes: By using MMisc you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, don't use the app.
A conta é pessoal. Você é responsável pe: The account is personal. You're responsible for what you post and for keeping access to your email or Google account.
O conteúdo continua sendo seu. Você nos: The content remains yours. You allow us to store and display it according to the visibility you choose. Don't post anything illegal, offensive, that violates other people's rights, or third parties' personal data.
Podemos remover conteúdo ou suspender co: We may remove content or suspend accounts that break these terms.
O MMisc é um projeto pessoal, oferecido: MMisc is a personal project, offered as is, for free. It may change, go offline or shut down; in that case, we'll give advance notice so you can request a copy of your data.
Envie um e-mail para {email} a partir do: Send an email to {email} from your account's email, with the subject “Delete my account”. Within 15 days we delete the account and everything linked to it: profile, reviews, photos, private notes, lists, likes, comments, friendships and invites. We reply confirming the deletion.
Em breve será possível fazer isso direto: Soon you'll be able to do this right from your Profile, without writing to us.
